items.q: Which feature best indicates that a fossil hominid walked upright (bipedally)?
items.qAf: Watter kenmerk dui die beste daarop dat ’n fossiel-hominied regop (tweevoetig) geloop het?
options: The position of the foramen magnum under the skull
The size of the canine teeth
optionsAf: The position of the foramen magnum under the skull
The size of the canine teeth
items.explain: A forward-positioned foramen magnum means the head sits on top of the spine, which is typical of bipedalism.
items.explainAf: ’n Vooruitgeplaaste foramen magnum beteken die kop sit bo-op die ruggraat, tipies van tweevoetigheid.

items.q: Which hominid group is associated with the first stone tools and a brain volume of about 600 cm³?
items.qAf: Watter hominiedgroep word geassosieer met die eerste klipgereedskap en ’n breinvolume van ongeveer 600 cm³?
items.explain: Homo habilis is linked to early stone tools and a larger brain than the australopithecines.
items.explainAf: Homo habilis word met vroeë klipgereedskap en ’n groter brein as die australopiteke geassosieer.

items.q: In which South African cave system was Homo naledi discovered?
items.qAf: In watter Suid-Afrikaanse grotstelsel is Homo naledi ontdek?
items.explain: Homo naledi was discovered in the Rising Star Cave system near Johannesburg.
items.explainAf: Homo naledi is in die Rising Star-grotstelsel naby Johannesburg ontdek.

items.q: Blombos Cave is important because it contains:
items.qAf: Blombos-grot is belangrik omdat dit bevat:
items.explain: Ochre and shell beads show symbolic and cultural behaviour in early modern humans.
items.explainAf: Oker en skulpbeaded wys simboliese en kulturele gedrag by vroeë moderne mense.

items.q: What does evidence of campfires at early hominid sites suggest?
items.qAf: Wat dui bewys van kampvure by vroeë hominiedterreine op?
options: Control of fire, possibly for cooking
The hominids were fully modern humans
optionsAf: Control of fire, possibly for cooking
The hominids were fully modern humans
items.explain: Controlled fire gave warmth, protection and possibly cooked food.
items.explainAf: Beheerde vuur het warmte, beskerming en moontlik gaar kos gegee.

items.q: Across hominid evolution, average brain volume generally increased. What does this trend suggest?
items.qAf: Dwarsdeur hominiedevolusie het die gemiddelde breinvolume algemeen toegeneem. Wat dui hierdie neiging op?
options: Brain size is unrelated to behaviour
optionsAf: Brain size is unrelated to behaviour
items.explain: Larger brains are linked to more complex behaviour, tools and social organisation.
items.explainAf: Groter brein word gekoppel aan meer komplekse gedrag, gereedskap en sosiale organisasie.
